Solar applications

Solutions built around your energy use

System design starts with the site, your electricity consumption and the way you use power throughout the day.

🏡

Residential rooftop solar

For independent homes and selected housing societies. Roof condition, shadow, sanctioned load and local utility rules should be assessed first.

🏢

Commercial solar

For shops, offices, schools and other commercial facilities seeking to evaluate on-site solar generation.

🏭

Industrial solar

For facilities with larger energy requirements, where load profile, roof structure and electrical infrastructure guide design.

🔌

Hybrid and backup systems

A combination of solar, grid supply, inverter and battery storage where the application calls for backup capability.

📊

Energy assessment

Review electricity bills, daytime loads, roof orientation and shading before deciding on system capacity.

🧾

Subsidy guidance

Eligibility and subsidy amounts depend on current government rules, approved equipment, vendor conditions and the applicable application process.

A sensible starting point

What we need to size a system

  • Recent electricity bills and monthly consumption
  • Property type and installation location
  • Available roof area and shading details
  • Daytime and evening power requirements
  • Backup expectations and future expansion plans

Important note on subsidies

The source design mentions PM Surya Ghar and subsidy assistance. Scheme amounts, eligibility and timelines can change. Check the official government portal and your DISCOM before making a financial decision. Sunpulse Tech should only advertise assistance it can actually provide.
